lastCompletedStory.title: Fix forkMonitor's dead retry-monitor child via resolveSelfInvokeArgv

nextStoryContext: forkMonitor (src/retry/launcher.ts) now delegates to resolveSelfInvokeArgv (src/util/self-invoke.ts) for its monitor-child argv, mirroring resolveOrchResolverCmd (src/commands/run.ts). Both call sites now share the single canonical fix site for the interpreted-vs-compiled self-invoke bug class; there are no other known local reimplementations of this pattern left in src/. test/retry/interactive.test.ts's two forkMonitor argv tests assert full-array equality for both shapes (interpreted: 5-token [execPath, argv1, 'retry-monitor', pane, pid]; compiled: 4-token [execPath, 'retry-monitor', pane, pid], swept red against the pre-fix construction) by monkeypatching process.execPath (via Object.defineProperty, since execPath is non-writable in this Bun version) and process.argv[1] around the forkMonitor call, restoring both in the same test body. scripts/file-size-budget.json's ceilings for src/retry/launcher.ts (323->329) and test/retry/interactive.test.ts (383->391) were raised in this story per the file-size gate's content.split('\n').length measurement (not wc -l); the _ref note documents both raises together since both files grew in the same story. patterns.md's CAM-425 US-R1-001 bullet no longer names forkMonitor as an unaddressed follow-up target -- it now records that forkMonitor shares the primitive as of this story.
